narr: Slow moving thunderstorms with rainfall rates as high as 5 inches per hour caused localized flooding in the City of Radford and neighboring Montgomery County. Heavy rain also caused flooding and a landslide in and around the Town of Rich Creek, VA.
ev: Crab Creek overflowed its banks and flooded across Walton Road. A water rescue was conducted as an automobile was stranded in the flooding. No damage was observed to the road, which was open to traffic after the flooding receded.
lsr: Crab Creek overflowed its banks and flooded Walton Road. A water rescue had to be done due to the flooding.
